lens: Opened all eighteen 1600x900 PNGs individually in progress order before reading capture-manifest.json, then cropped and magnified with sips to settle claims that could go either way: the under-kart region of penguin-village-p0_33/p0_45 and comeback-city-p0_67, the sky band of comeback-city-p0_33, the kart side profile and driver seat, the curb and off-track verge, and the dark slab at comeback-city-p0_45 frame right. Manifest is genuinely clean: consoleErrors [] on both tracks, 18/18 captured, 0 missed, no timeout, 58-65 fps with frameElapsedMs pinned 15.4-17.1. What separates this build from the bar is not the wave's work, it is everything the wave was not allowed to touch: nothing except the karts casts a shadow anywhere in eighteen frames, the karts have a detached blob and no contact patch, the curbs are painted rather than extruded, and every off-track surface on both tracks is a flat untextured colour fill.
headline: Ten of eleven axes sit under 8 — lighting, materials, environment and vfx at 5 are what pin it, with tyres visibly hovering over unmarked road in comeback-city-p0_9 and penguin-village-p0_45 and untextured black placeholder slabs standing shadowless in comeback-city-p0_45.
blockers: Karts have no contact with the ground. In the magnified crop of penguin-village-p0_45 the rear-left tyre hangs with a clean silhouette against fully lit asphalt and the only dark pixel is a detached smudge well behind the axle; comeback-city-p0_9 shows zero darkening at the contact patch.

Geometry a player reads as unfinished: comeback-city-p0_45 carries a solid near-black rectangular box at (1225-1364, 330-431) with no top face, no windows and no ground shadow; comeback-city-p0_33 has the same untextured navy quad at (280-440, 445-475).

Props and buildings cast nothing at all. The tyre stack at (75-190, 455-495) and the purple crate at (300-465, 405-440) in comeback-city-p0_67 float on the verge with no contact darkening; same for every igloo and rock in penguin-village-p0_45/p0_56.

nextFixes.title: Kart has a cast blob but no contact shadow — tyres visibly hover
nextFixes.fix: Add a per-kart contact-shadow decal independent of the shadow map: an alpha-mapped radial-gradient plane parented to the chassis, offset along the track surface normal by ~2cm, radius and opacity driven by suspension compression so it tightens under the tyres rather than sitting behind them. Separately shrink the split key's caster shadow-camera frustum around the player so the cast shadow gains a defined penumbra.

nextFixes.title: Untextured black placeholder slabs standing in the city
nextFixes.fix: Give the mid-ground building material a facade: a tiling window atlas on diffuse plus a separate emissive mask for lit windows, and a distinct top-face material tinted toward the key so the box silhouette resolves into a roof and two walls.

nextFixes.title: Nothing but the kart is in the shadow-casting set
nextFixes.fix: Set castShadow on the scenery instanced meshes and add a cheap baked AO ring to each prop's base geometry so tyre stacks, crates, igloos and rocks bite into the ground plane instead of resting on it.

nextFixes.title: Curbs are painted decals, not 3D rumble strips
nextFixes.fix: Extrude the road edge profile so the red/white band becomes a raised lip 8-12cm proud of the asphalt with a chamfered inner face, alternating segment heights by ~1cm. The magnified crop shows the red band, cyan glow line and stripe all coplanar with both road and verge.

nextFixes.title: Penguin Village snow section: road and off-track are the same material
nextFixes.fix: Driving surface and verge are the identical pale-grey speckled material separated only by a flat painted strip. Differentiate them: compacted tyre grooves and a darker value on the road, lighter and coarser sparkle on the verge, so the edge survives without the curb decal.

nextFixes.title: Every off-track surface is a large flat untextured expanse
nextFixes.fix: Apply a triplanar detail-normal plus a low-frequency macro-variation mask to the ground plane material. The comeback-city-p0_67 crop samples a single uniform dark grey-brown across the entire left third; the asphalt already has grain, so the disparity is what makes the world read as a plane with decals on it.

nextFixes.title: No driver in the seat — a disembodied head over an empty chair
nextFixes.fix: The side profile shows an unoccupied seat and a steering wheel with nothing holding it, while a black head-and-ears sits forward of and above the chassis with no torso or arms. Parent the character mesh to a seat socket with a real torso and add arm meshes locked to the wheel rim.

nextFixes.title: Shield reads as a dull grey soap bubble that swallows the kart
nextFixes.fix: Replace the flat-opacity ellipsoid with an additive fresnel shell: opacity driven by view angle so the rim is bright and the centre near-transparent, plus a scrolling pattern in the emissive channel and an impact-flash uniform.

nextFixes.title: Sky implies two or three suns at once
nextFixes.fix: A soft white sun disc at (240,85) plus two separate baked horizon hotspots at ~(150,470) and ~(940,430) — three light sources at three azimuths. Strip the hotspots from the sky gradient texture and drive a single horizon glow procedurally from the key light's azimuth.

nextFixes.title: Penguin Village sky is a muddy blurred band with no cloud form
nextFixes.fix: The upper third is an out-of-focus grey-brown smear with no cloud silhouette and a dirty desaturated purple at the zenith. Raise the dome texture resolution or move to an analytic gradient, and add a scrolling cloud layer with real alpha silhouettes.

nextFixes.title: Ice spires read as stalactites hanging in open air
nextFixes.fix: The pale masses at (560-1000, 0-330) are wide at the top of frame and taper to points terminating above the visible snow plain. Invert the taper for the near band — widen the bases and sink them into a visible plinth of snow — and reserve the needle silhouette for the far haze layer only.

nextFixes.title: Camera does not respond to speed
nextFixes.fix: 290 km/h and 233 km/h frames have identical framing geometry — same kart screen size, same horizon height, same road-ahead compression. Drive camera FOV from a normalised speed term (+8 to +12 degrees across the band) with an asymmetric ease, and add a small positional lag on the same term.

nextFixes.title: Bloom is firing on non-emitters
nextFixes.fix: The art-deco tower at (330-500, 80-440) carries a halo and every ice spire wears a bright cream rim, so bloom reads off bright diffuse rather than genuine emitters. Raise the bloom luminance threshold above the brightest diffuse albedo and move neon, window emissives and exhaust glow to a dedicated emissive-only pass.

nextFixes.title: Mute button in the driver's sightline; item slot reads unfinished; no course map
nextFixes.fix: The speaker button sits dead-centre at (780-820, 20-58) in all eighteen captures, over the vanishing point of the road — move it to the corner cluster or a pause menu. Replace the dashed-outline ITEM square with a filled recessed slot. And add a course map: there is no minimap anywhere in eighteen frames.

outOfScopeNoted: Untextured black placeholder building slabs in comeback-city — a CC asset problem, not the PV key light.
Flat painted curbs on both tracks — shared road edge geometry this wave's package does not own.
Flat untextured off-track ground planes on both tracks.
The driver is not seated in the kart — createKartModel.js, untouched by this wave.
Shield VFX reading as a grey soap bubble — raceVfx.js.
Multiple implied suns and the muddy Penguin Village sky — createSkyDome.js.
Bloom on non-emitting diffuse geometry — racePostChain.js, Phase 6 territory.
Camera FOV does not respond to speed — chaseCameraFeel.js.
HUD: top-centre mute button, dashed placeholder item slot, no course map.
Penguin Village mid-ground reuses the same faceted grey rock mesh roughly a dozen times — createMidGroundBelt.js.

CREDIT, and later DISPUTED: this critic read the split-key change as landed, citing a magnified under-kart crop of penguin-village-p0_33. Adjudicated against it — see the file-level note at the end of this array.

lens: Opened all 18 PNGs at full size in track order, then read capture-manifest.json, then cut eight 1:1 crops to judge what fit-width display hides — kart/road contact, kart surface, a facade, the PV skyline band, the snow-covered road and the position pill. Three claims measured rather than eyeballed in PIL: (a) shadow presence as the ratio of 5th-percentile to median luminance of the road band y620-880 excluding the kart bbox — 0.70-0.76 where a shadow exists, 0.89-0.94 where none does; (b) surface grain as stddev of a lane-line-free asphalt patch — 1.95-2.24 of 255; (c) sky seams as >7-luminance steps in 4px down sky columns — every transition found was a multi-step ramp or a HUD edge, so there is no dome seam and I dropped that blocker. Also withdrew a suspected chromatic aberration on the ice rims after sampling showed an authored warm-to-cool sunset rim ramp.
headline: Two automatic blockers — the kart never makes contact with the ground in any of the 18 frames, and Penguin Village's ice ridge hangs in mid-air in seven of nine — with lighting and materials both at 4 and environment at 5.
blockers: Kart has no contact with the ground in any of the 18 frames. At 1:1 the tyres meet the asphalt with zero darkening — the road under the contact patch is the same value as the road 300px away. No AO contact patch anywhere, either track, any progress point.

The cast shadow is missing outright in 7 of 9 Penguin Village frames (p0_06, p0_15, p0_24, p0_56, p0_67, p0_78, p0_9 measure 0.89-0.93) and 4 of 9 Comeback City frames (0.91-0.94). THIS WAVE'S SPLIT KEY LIGHT DID NOT LAND.

Floating geometry: the Penguin Village ice ridge hangs from the sky. Forms are widest at their tops, taper to points, and terminate in mid-air above the snow plain with horizon glow visible beneath. Present in seven of nine frames.
Every static prop is equally ungrounded: the ice-cream van and tyre stack, the igloos and snowman plinth, and the rune stone all sit with no shadow and no base darkening.

nextFixes.title: Give the kart a contact shadow that touches the tyres, independent of sun direction
nextFixes.fix: Add a per-kart blob/contact-shadow pass: a radial-alpha plane parented to the kart, projected onto the track normal a few mm above the surface, opacity driven by ride height. This is the grounding cue that must exist even when the sun is behind the camera and the directional shadow is hidden by the kart — precisely the 7 PV / 4 CC frames measuring 0.89-0.94. Keep it separate from the directional shadow map so it cannot be lost to cascade coverage.

nextFixes.title: The Penguin Village split key still produces no cast shadow over most of the lap
nextFixes.frame: penguin-village-p0_06.png, p0_15, p0_24, p0_56, p0_67, p0_78, p0_9
nextFixes.fix: The 20-degree caster half is not covering the kart for most of PV. Fit the shadow camera's ortho frustum to the kart rather than the track origin (fixed-size ortho box following the kart, snapped to texel grid to stop crawl). Verify with the same metric: 5th-percentile over median of the road band y620-880 excluding the kart bbox must land under 0.80 on all nine PV points.

nextFixes.title: Enable cast shadows on static scenery props
nextFixes.fix: raceShadowRig.js:597 sets mesh.castShadow = false on the scenery walk and :859 only opts in a subset. Extend the opt-in to near-track dressing inside a radius of the racing line so cost is bounded, plus a baked AO decal under each prop footprint for props outside the cascade.

nextFixes.title: The Penguin Village ice ridge floats above the horizon line
nextFixes.fix: The backdrop plate carries the ice-ridge silhouette but its painted forms terminate above the plate's own base. Drop the silhouettes' lower bound to the plate's bottom edge and skirt them into the far snow value, or move the ridge onto real instanced geometry on the ground plane. Verify by scanning any column through a ridge tip and confirming no sky-value run between tip and snow plane.

nextFixes.title: Asphalt is an untextured flat colour across ~45% of every frame
nextFixes.fix: createTrackMesh.js:17 builds asphaltMat as MeshStandardMaterial with only a flat colour — no map, no roughnessMap, no normalMap. Measured stddev of a lane-line-free patch is 1.95/255. Add a tiling aggregate albedo + roughness pair and break roughness along the racing line. One texture pair, and it fixes the largest surface in the game.

nextFixes.title: Comeback City facades are flat slabs with pasted rectangles
nextFixes.fix: A single mauve slab fills ~60% of frame width at full height with one trim strip; solid-orange window rectangles with no mullions, reflectance or corner AO. Give near-band buildings a facade material with a tiling window-grid emissive map plus a vertical gradient darkening toward the base, reserving flat slabs for the far haze ring.

nextFixes.title: No drift sparks, and the exhaust plume is identical in all 18 frames
nextFixes.fix: Three mid-corner frames at 233 km/h stage not a single spark, and the same orange exhaust blob appears at 228 and 290 km/h. Gate plume size and colour temperature on throttle and boost state, and stage drift sparks as three colour tiers emitted from the outside rear tyre as drift charge crosses each threshold.

nextFixes.title: Camera does not respond to speed at all
nextFixes.frame: penguin-village-p0_06 vs p0_24, comeback-city-p0_67 vs p0_33
nextFixes.fix: Kart on-screen width is 216px at 228 km/h and 225px at 286 km/h — a 4% change for a 25% speed change — with the horizon at the same height in both. Drive fov from normalised speed (62 to 74 degrees) with an asymmetric ease, add positional lag on the boom, and a low-amplitude speed-scaled shake.

nextFixes.title: The driver is invisible from the chase camera
nextFixes.fix: At 1:1 the only evidence of a driver is two black ears above the seat back — no head, no torso, no hands, and the roll cage in front is an indistinct dark mass. Raise the driver rig so head and shoulders clear the seat back at the chase camera's pitch, add a rim light term from toonRimShader.js, and lean the torso into steering.

nextFixes.title: Comeback City curbs are painted decals, not 3D rumble strips
nextFixes.fix: The curb-to-road edge ramps 59 to 193 over 5px with no relief shading on the inner face and no shadow line at its base. Penguin Village already gets this right — extend the raised-curb profile to the Comeback City edge case so the blocks have a lit top and a dark inner face.

nextFixes.title: The snow-covered stretch collapses road-versus-shoulder contrast
nextFixes.fix: Road surface measures mean 165.9 / sd 11.7 and the right-side surface 153.0 / sd 7.0 against a shoulder at 121-153 of the same material family. Either darken the snow-over-asphalt blend so the ribbon stays 25% below the shoulder, or keep two wheel-cleared asphalt tracks through the section. Randomise the blotch decal UV offset per segment to kill visible tiling.

nextFixes.title: The shield item reads as an opaque plastic balloon
nextFixes.fix: The shield swallows the kart — body, driver and silhouette are lost behind it, and the four white diamonds read as stickers. Rebuild as a fresnel shell: near-zero alpha at centre rising sharply at grazing angles, additive blending, a hex-cell scroll in the fresnel band, and a pulse on hit.

nextFixes.title: Snow particles are inconsistently scaled blobs and smeared streaks
nextFixes.fix: 4px specks and 25px balls appear in the same frame at the same apparent depth, plus elongated white streaks near the road that read as debris. Scale sprite size by actual distance from camera instead of randomising, cap near-field size, and split streaks into a separate short-lived spray emitter bound to the wheels.

nextFixes.title: No tonemap shoulder — the CC sky clips flat and the PV whiteout goes muddy
nextFixes.fix: CC's sky is featureless uniform orange from y100 to y260; PV's upper band is a grey-purple wash and its lower half sits at one value (sd 11.7). AA and vignette are genuinely clean (edges resolve over 1-3px; corner 89 vs centre 142), so the fix is the transfer curve, not the resolve: switch to ACES or AgX with an explicit shoulder and add a mild S-curve in raceGrade.js.

nextFixes.title: Comeback City reuses one silhouette across the whole skyline
nextFixes.fix: The same swoosh-sail building appears at least eight times in p0_33 alone at different scales but identical silhouette. Add three or four more silhouette archetypes to the instanced pool, vary rotation as well as scale, and reserve the tallest slot for one non-instanced landmark per track.

nextFixes.title: HUD has no minimap and no rival order
nextFixes.fix: The HUD is the strongest axis in the build — the position pill is crisp, unclipped and correctly hierarchised, and the item slot genuinely animates from placeholder to a lit shield tile. What is missing is spatial information: no track map showing lap shape or where the other racers are, so 'POSITION 4TH +0.9S' tells you the gap but never who or where. Add a corner minimap with a static track spline and live racer dots.

outOfScopeNoted: The floating PV ice ridge is the second automatic blocker but sits outside this wave's package — it must be the first item of the next package.
The untextured asphalt material (createTrackMesh.js:17, measured stddev 1.95/255) is the single largest materials defect and belongs to the Phase 2 materials package.
CC's flat facade slabs and repeated skyline silhouette belong to the Phase 2 environment package.
Missing drift sparks and the state-blind exhaust plume belong to Phase 5, which is also where the deferred Motion & feel axis gets its scorer.
The camera's total lack of speed response belongs to Phase 5.
The tonemap shoulder and grade S-curve belong to the Phase 6 post package.
The invisible driver and the opaque shield shell are real but neither a blocker nor this wave's work.

Frame integrity is clean and should not be touched: consoleErrors empty on both tracks, 9/9 points captured with no misses or timeouts, fps 58-65, draw calls stable at 571 CC / 875 PV, triangle counts constant.

lens: Read the brief and rubric, then capture-manifest.json, then opened all eighteen PNGs at full size in progress order. Because the manifest was clean and the frames were not cyan noise, the deciding work was done in crops: 2x-6x LANCZOS and NEAREST crops of every under-kart region, every prop base, three high-contrast edges and the near-field particle field, plus a PIL luminance probe on a 170x70 band directly under the kart against two identical bands 300px left and right at the same y. That probe separated the two tracks and is what the verdict rests on: Comeback City p0_45 reads 44.2 under against 55.5/65.3 lateral, a real shadow; Penguin Village p0_67 reads 53.4 against 48.9/60.2 (BRIGHTER under the kart than beside it), p0_9 reads 57.9 against 56.6/59.1, and p0_33 on white snow reads 152.5 against 166.8/153.6. Penguin Village has no kart shadow in any of its nine frames — the exact axis this wave's package claimed to fix.
headline: Penguin Village renders nine consecutive frames of a kart with measurably zero ground contact and Comeback City p0_56 has a translucent phantom wheel lying on the road, so lighting (3) and vfx (5) pin the fail before materials (5), post (5), camera (6) and environment (6) are even counted.
blockers: Kart with no shadow / no contact with the ground — ALL NINE penguin-village frames. Measured under-kart vs lateral road at identical y: p0_67 53.4 vs 48.9/60.2, p0_9 57.9 vs 56.6/59.1, p0_33 152.5 vs 166.8/153.6 on white snow. The 2x crop of p0_33 shows tyres meeting bright snow with no contact patch, no cast ribbon and no AO. This is the axis the wave's split key was supposed to fix and it is not on screen.
Kart with no shadow — comeback-city-p0_9. The shielded kart at x480-880 has no shadow, cast or contact, on the asphalt beneath it.

Geometry a player reads as broken — comeback-city-p0_56, a translucent grey WHEEL (two overlapping discs with a visible hub) lying on the road at ~(800,660), fully detached from the kart, plus two unlit beige ovals. Confirmed at 3x LANCZOS and 2x NEAREST so it is not a resampling artefact.

Props with no contact with the ground — the PV penguin landmark plinth meets snow on a hard silhouette edge with zero darkening; p0_78's capped post, mound and stone plinth sit on uniform grey; comeback-city-p0_33 has ~twenty buildings on a lit plain with a sun visible in frame and not one casts anything.

nextFixes.title: PV's shadow caster carries 35% of the key and points down the camera axis, so its shadow is both too weak and hidden under the kart body
nextFixes.fix: penguinVillage.js has sun: { azimuthDeg: 195, distance: 190, elevationDeg: 12, shadowKey: { elevationDeg: 20, share: 0.35 } }. Two one-line changes. (1) share 0.35 caps the shadow at 35% of direct light, which against the hemisphere fill on snow is a few percent of framebuffer value — raise the caster's share toward 0.85-1.0 and let the non-casting 12-degree look light carry the fill, since the azimuth is shared and the lit/shade authoring does not move. (2) azimuth 195 throws the ribbon along the view vector where the chassis occludes it — offset the CASTER's azimuth 40-60 degrees off the track heading via a shadowKey.azimuthDeg override, leaving the look light at 195 so the ice shading is untouched. Gate on the probe: mean luminance of a 170x70 band under the kart must be at least 25% below two identical bands 300px left and right at the same y, on p0_33, p0_67 and p0_9.

nextFixes.title: Tier-3 static contact darkening never reaches Penguin Village's props
nextFixes.fix: raceShadowRig.js documents a tier-3 instanced contact-darkening pass at every prop base, two draw calls for the world. It is not landing on PV. Verify the tier-3 emitter is being fed PV's scenery instance list at all — PV runs 875 draw calls to CC's 571, so if the pass is keyed off the CC scenery builder it will silently skip. Then scale the patch radius off each prop's bounding-sphere radius rather than a constant, because PV's props span a far wider size range than CC's, and clamp the multiply so white snow darkens by at least 12 luminance values at the base.

nextFixes.title: Surface-dust sprites are unlit grey quads and one reads as a phantom tyre on the road
nextFixes.fix: The dust/smoke sprites are drawn with a flat unlit material at fixed mid-grey, so on CC's purple asphalt they read as dirt smears and at p0_56 the double-disc sprite reads unmistakably as a detached wheel. Multiply the sprite tint by the scene's key+ambient (or key off raceSceneTheme's per-track grade), cut max sprite scale so no puff exceeds a third of tyre width on screen, and give each puff a rise+fade so it cannot sit static on the road. Replace the double-disc silhouette with a single soft radial falloff — the current shape is what makes it read as geometry.

nextFixes.title: Snowfall renders as 80px opaque white spheres at the track edge
nextFixes.fix: An 85px near-opaque white disc sits on the curb at ~(285,600) in p0_56, another at (1370,130) in p0_24 and (650,435) in p0_45. They read as stray balls or lens dirt. Clamp near-plane sprite scale (size should fall off with distance, not grow), drop peak alpha to ~0.35 for any flake within 6 units of the camera, and add horizontal drift so the field has direction.

nextFixes.title: No anti-aliasing on high-contrast track edges
nextFixes.fix: A 6x NEAREST crop of the shoulder at (1150,470)-(1330,560) shows single-pixel stair steps with no intermediate blend pixels on the cyan neon edge and the chevron rumble strip; the window rectangles on the near tower step the same way. Add an FXAA or SMAA pass at the end of racePostChain.js, or set antialias/samples on the render target if the chain runs multisampled targets.

nextFixes.title: Penguin Village's snow-covered track is the same value as its run-off
nextFixes.fix: Measured: drivable surface 130.2, off-track snow left 128.9, right 134.0 — a 3% separation, with only a 3px cyan line marking the boundary at 255 km/h. Either darken the snow-track material by 15-20% so the ribbon reads as plowed against untouched drift, or add a raised snow bank at the shoulder so the edge is a silhouette rather than a value change. The asphalt sections of the same track (road 57 vs snow 130) prove the target is achievable.

nextFixes.title: Chase camera swings to a low near-side angle that loses the road ahead
nextFixes.fix: In p0_9 the kart sits at x480-880, left of centre, at roughly twice its usual screen size, with the racing line exiting frame right and the left third occupied by a building wall — almost no readable road ahead. Separately framing is identical at 229 and 290 km/h. Clamp the yaw offset the drift/turn term may apply so the kart never leaves the middle third horizontally, and drive FOV off speed (62 to 74 degrees) with a short ease.

nextFixes.title: Every surface except the kart is flat colour plus faint noise
nextFixes.fix: The off-track plain is one untextured olive gradient across the entire left half; buildings are flat quads with painted window rectangles; PV's snow is flat grey with a visibly repeating dot speckle, no sparkle, no scatter. The kart is the only object with a real specular, which proves the material path can carry this. Give ground and building materials a roughness/normal contribution rather than a colour constant — a triplanar detail normal on the terrain and low-frequency roughness break-up on the slabs.

nextFixes.title: Shield bubble is a grey glassy egg with three flat diamond decals
nextFixes.fix: The shield desaturates the whole kart to grey and reads as a plastic shell rather than energy. Drive the bubble with a fresnel-weighted additive rim, tint it to the item's colour, and animate the diamond decals along the surface so the state change reads on pickup.

nextFixes.title: Mid-ground silhouettes repeat visibly and the plain is empty
nextFixes.fix: The same concave-swoosh tower silhouette appears six or more times per frame, and the plain between road and skyline is bare for hundreds of units in every direction. Add per-instance non-uniform scale and small yaw jitter so the swoosh reads as a family rather than a stamp, and seed low-cost ground dressing into the empty band between curb and belt.

nextFixes.title: Empty item slot reads as unimplemented UI and a browser mute button sits centre-frame
nextFixes.fix: The idle item slot is a dashed grey rectangle in 16 of 18 frames, reading as a placeholder rather than an empty slot — give it a filled recessed well with a subtle idle shimmer. Separately the speaker/mute control floats at (800,40) dead centre over the play field in all 18 frames; move it into the top-right cluster.

nextFixes.title: Two implied suns in the same Comeback City frame
nextFixes.fix: p0_33 has a flat pale sun disc at ~(240,90) with a soft halo AND a separate bright orange horizon glow at ~(770,310); p0_45 repeats it. Bind the sky dome's horizon glow position to the same azimuth the key light uses so bloom and disc agree, instead of the glow being baked at the centre of the gradient.

outOfScopeNoted: Comeback City buildings cast nothing on a lit plain — the CC key at 21 degrees casts for the kart but no static geometry is in the caster set.
CC's grade is so orange-dominant that sky, skyline, ground and haze occupy one narrow hue band with no value separation in the mid-ground — Phase 6 owns the post chain.
Mid-ground objects are markedly blurrier than both near and far field, which reads as broken DOF or an over-strong bloom veil rather than depth.
The driver reads as a featureless black mass from the chase camera in every frame.
No minimap or track map anywhere in the HUD, and no lap-split panel, on a 2m14s course.
The penguin landmark is a smooth untextured cone with a flat triangle beak and two flat ovals — the single biggest landmark in either track and the lowest-craft asset in the eighteen frames.
PV's cloud layer is one blurry grey smear band with no form and no parallax; CC's has form but is a single non-parallaxing plane.
